signals.thesis: Gemini 4 Argon has been unveiled alongside a dedicated Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics release, expanding the model family into robotics applications.
signals.title: Gemini 4 Argon and Robotics variant released

signals.thesis: Ledger confirmed that a hidden spy chip implant in compromised hardware wallets, including the Ledger Nano X, is behind recent cryptocurrency thefts. The hardware tampering highlights supply-chain and physical security risks for self-custody crypto devices.
signals.title: Ledger confirms hidden spy chip implant behind hardware wallet crypto thefts
